body.zh-Hant: 梅塔克薩斯生於1871年4月12日，出生地是伊薩基島，1890年畢業於軍事學院。他在1899至1903年間赴柏林繼續軍事研究。1914年第一次世界大戰爆發時，他是總參謀部的第二把手；在首相威尼澤洛斯與國王君士坦丁的爭執中，參考百科記他於1915年升任總參謀長，站在國王一側並辭職。
body.en: Metaxas was born on 12 April 1871 on the island of Ithaca and graduated from the Military Academy in 1890. He went to Berlin for military studies in 1899–1903. When the First World War broke out in 1914 he was second in command of the General Staff; in the dispute between Prime Minister Venizelos and King Constantine, the reference entry says, he was promoted to chief in 1915, sided with the king and resigned.

body.zh-Hant: 梅塔克薩斯於1922年轉入政界，創立自由思想者黨。1926年選舉中，他的政黨在議會取得54席，之後的選舉未能重現這個成績。1936年選舉中，他只得到4%選票，當選議員7人；同年3月，國王喬治二世任命他為戰爭部長。
body.en: Metaxas moved into politics in 1922 and founded the Freethinkers' Party. In the 1926 election his party won 54 seats, but it did not repeat that result later. In the 1936 election he polled only 4 percent and seven deputies were elected; in March 1936 King George II appointed him minister of war.

body.zh-Hant: 總理德梅爾齊斯去世後，國王於1936年4月13日任命梅塔克薩斯為總理。官方內閣名單記他當日獲任為部長會議主席與戰爭部長，並暫時兼理空軍，同日又受指派暫代外交部長職務。8月4日，他以次日將舉行總罷工為由宣布緊急狀態、解散議會；其獨裁統治由此展開。1940年10月28日，義大利發出最後通牒，梅塔克薩斯拒絕；他於1941年1月29日逝世。
body.en: After Prime Minister Demertzis died, the king appointed Metaxas prime minister on 13 April 1936. The official cabinet list records his appointment that day as President of the Council of Ministers and Minister of Military Affairs, provisionally also Air, and the same day the duties of Foreign Minister were temporarily assigned to him. On 4 August he declared a state of emergency and dissolved parliament, citing a general strike scheduled for the next day, and his dictatorship followed. Italy issued an ultimatum on 28 October 1940, which Metaxas rejected; he died on 29 January 1941.

body.zh-Hant: 希臘政府的歷屆內閣名單顯示，梅塔克薩斯任總理期間陸續兼管多個部。1936年7月2日，他兼任海軍部長；同年8月4日，他又暫兼財政部長。1938年11月25日，他兼任教育部長，名單同列他兼管戰爭、外交、空軍與海軍各部。
body.en: The official list of Greek cabinets shows Metaxas taking on several ministries while prime minister. On 2 July 1936 he was also made Minister of the Navy, and on 4 August 1936 he became provisional Minister of Finance. On 25 November 1938 he was made Minister of Education as well, and the list places the Military, Foreign, Air and Navy ministries in his hands at that date.

body.zh-Hant: 泰曼特1872年9月24日生於當時屬萊內馬（Läänemaa）的伊盧斯泰。他就讀於特雷夫納私立文理中學，1901年畢業於聖彼得堡大學法學院。1904至1905年，他是塔林市議會議員。他參與1905年革命，同年逃往瑞士，並被缺席判處死刑。1908年戒嚴結束後，他回到愛沙尼亞。
body.en: Teemant was born on 24 September 1872 at Illuste, then in Läänemaa. He studied at H. Treffner's private gymnasium and graduated from the law department of St Petersburg University in 1901. In 1904–1905 he sat on the Tallinn municipal council. He took part in the 1905 revolution, fled to Switzerland the same year and was sentenced to death in absentia. He returned to Estonia in 1908, after the state of war ended.

body.zh-Hant: 1917至1919年，泰曼特是愛沙尼亞省議會（Maanõukogu）議員。共和國初期，他被任命為愛沙尼亞共和國首任檢察長，任期為1918年11月11日至1919年4月7日；他當選制憲會議議員後，轉任新的職務。1919年6月14日，律師公會（Vannutatud Advokaatide Nõukogu）成立，他當日起擔任該會主席，直到出任國家長老為止。1919至1920年，他同時是制憲會議議員。
body.en: In 1917–1919 Teemant was a member of the Estonian Provincial Assembly (Maanõukogu). Early in the republic he was appointed Estonia's first prosecutor, serving from 11 November 1918 to 7 April 1919; once elected to the Constituent Assembly he moved to new duties. On 14 June 1919 the Council of Sworn Advocates was founded and he headed it from that day until he became State Elder. In 1919–1920 he was also a member of the Constituent Assembly.

body.zh-Hant: 泰曼特曾四度出任愛沙尼亞國家長老（riigivanem）。國家總理府的新聞稿記他的任期是1925至1927年與1932年；總統府頁面列出的任期之一為1925年12月15日至1927年12月9日，另一段為1932年2月19日至7月19日。耶爾維萊德教授寫道，他的政府的內政部長卡雷爾·埃恩帕魯，當時積極推動警政更新。
body.en: Teemant was State Elder (riigivanem) four times. The State Chancellery notice gives his terms as 1925–1927 and 1932; the president.ee page lists one term as 15 December 1925 to 9 December 1927 and another as 19 February to 19 July 1932. Professor Järvelaid writes that Kaarel Eenpalu, the interior minister in his government, was then actively renewing the police.

citations.quote: Jaan Teemant oli neljakordne riigivanem aastatel 1925-1927 ja 1932.
Sel ajal saab alguse J.Teemanti valitsuse siseministri Kaarel Eenpalu
aktiivne tegevus Eesti politsei uuendamisel

body.zh-Hant: 1936年10月30日，泰曼特與托尼松、庫克、皮普三位前任國家長老，在國民會議（Rahvuskogu）選舉之前聯名致函國家守護者康斯坦丁·帕茨，強調唯有合法秩序與真正自由的選舉，國民會議才有權威。1939至1940年，他是德國託管政府中的愛沙尼亞託管人。1940年7月23日，他被蘇聯內務人民委員部逮捕，據信在塔林被槍決，或死於塔林中央監獄。
body.en: On 30 October 1936, before the National Assembly elections, Teemant, with fellow former State Elders Tõnisson, Kukk and Piip, sent a memorandum to the State Guardian Konstantin Päts stressing that only lawful order and truly free elections would give the Assembly authority. In 1939–1940 he was the Estonian trustee in the German Trustee Government. On 23 July 1940 he was arrested by the NKVD; he was probably shot in Tallinn or died in the Tallinn Central Prison.

body.zh-Hant: 托尼松1868年12月22日（舊曆12月10日）生於維利揚迪鄉。大學期間，他在1891至1892年任愛沙尼亞學生會主席，1892年取得塔爾圖大學法學候補博士學位。他在朋友協助下買下《郵報》（Postimees）；總統府頁面記他1896至1930年擁有該報，1896至1935年任總編輯。
body.en: Tõnisson was born on 22 December 1868 (10 December in the old calendar) in Viljandi parish. As a student he chaired the Estonian Students' Society in 1891–1892 and took the cand. jur. degree at Tartu University in 1892. With the help of friends he bought the newspaper Postimees; the presidential page says he owned it in 1896–1930 and was editor-in-chief in 1896–1935.

body.zh-Hant: 1906年，托尼松與奧斯卡·呂特利一起，以利沃尼亞農民代表的身分當選俄羅斯帝國第一屆國家杜馬議員。他在1917至1918年主持新生愛沙尼亞共和國的外交代表團，1918至1919年是不管部部長，1919至1920年任總理（peaminister）。1919至1920年，他也是制憲會議議員。
body.en: In 1906 Tõnisson, together with Oskar Rütli, was elected as a deputy of the Livonian peasants to the first Duma of the Russian Empire. In 1917–1918 he led the foreign delegation of the emerging Republic of Estonia, in 1918–1919 he was a minister without portfolio, and in 1919–1920 prime minister (peaminister). In 1919–1920 he was also a member of the Constituent Assembly.

body.zh-Hant: 托尼松是第一至第六屆國會議員（1920至1934年與1938至1940年），1923至1925年與1932至1933年兩度擔任國會議長。國會官方歷史頁記，第二屆國會議長到1925年5月27日為托尼松。他在1927至1928年與1933年出任國家長老（riigivanem）。他任外交部長的年份有兩種記法：總統府頁面寫1931至1932年，文學博物館條目寫1930至1932年。
body.en: Tõnisson sat in the first to sixth Riigikogu (1920–1934 and 1938–1940) and was its Speaker twice, in 1923–1925 and 1932–1933. The Riigikogu's history page records him as Speaker of the II Riigikogu until 27 May 1925. He was State Elder (riigivanem) in 1927–1928 and 1933. His years as foreign minister are given two ways: 1931–1932 on the presidential page and 1930–1932 in the Literary Museum entry.

heading.en: Party leader, later years and arrest (1919–1940)

body.zh-Hant: 在愛沙尼亞共和國時期，托尼松領導人民黨（Eesti Rahvaerakond，1919至1932年），其後領導國民中央黨（Rahvuslik Keskerakond，1932至1935年）。1935年他因政治原因被免去《郵報》總編輯職務；1935至1939年，他在塔爾圖大學任合作學教授。總統府頁面記他於1940年12月被蘇聯內務人民委員部逮捕，據某些資料說，他於1941年7月在塔林被槍決。
body.en: Under the Republic of Estonia Tõnisson led the Estonian People's Party (Eesti Rahvaerakond, 1919–1932) and then the National Centre Party (Rahvuslik Keskerakond, 1932–1935). In 1935 he was removed as editor-in-chief of Postimees for political reasons; in 1935–1939 he was professor of cooperation at Tartu University. The presidential page says the NKVD arrested him in December 1940 and, according to some data, he was shot in Tallinn in July 1941.
